request.prompt:
Describe actual visible changes in chronological RGB frames. Bind entities across time. Record at most three persistent changes or reversals, and a neutral initial scene context. Robot-only motion, camera movement and occlusion are not automatically environment changes. Do not infer purpose, utility, completion or a task plan. Return only V1 JSON.
OUTPUT CONTRACT: Exact top keys: initial_context, changes, coverage, uncertainty. initial_context item keys: entity_id, description, region_id, visible_relation (max 6). changes item keys: change_id, entity_ids, before_refs, after_refs, before, after, observation, status (max 3). Use only supplied evidence IDs. The observation field is a fixed certainty label: write exactly "observed" or "uncertain", never descriptive prose; put the visual description in before and after. status=closed_event|open_event. coverage=complete|overflow|occluded|no_observable_change. uncertainty items have code, detail.
CPU_SEARCH_HINT (may be wrong): camera_uncertain=false; candidate_count=3; candidate_overflow=false. Inspect all supplied full frames.
